tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Authenticate this MCP session with a RetroDiffusion public API key.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Clear the authenticated RetroDiffusion API key for this MCP session.

tools.name: create_user_style
tools.description:
Create a user style from the public RD Pro template using /v2/styles.

Use `style_reference_images` and `style_reference_caption` for style-level references.
These are baked into the custom style and are not the same as per-inference `reference_images`.

tools.name: update_user_style
tools.description:
Update a public RD Pro user style using /v2/styles/{style_id}.

Use `style_reference_images` and `style_reference_caption` for style-level references.
These are baked into the custom style and are not the same as per-inference `reference_images`.

tools.name: delete_user_style
tools.description:
Delete a user style using /v2/styles/{style_id}.
style_id can be either internal id or prompt_style/public_id.

tools.name: list_available_styles
tools.description:
List publicly available styles from /v2/styles/selector.
Use this to discover valid prompt_style values plus style metadata such as require_input_image and supports_reference_images.

tools.name: list_available_models
tools.description: Return unique public model identifiers available in /v2/styles/selector.

tools.name: get_style_usage
tools.description:
Explain how to use a public prompt_style from the RetroDiffusion API.

Use this before create_inference if you are unsure whether a style expects `input_image`,
supports per-inference `reference_images`, or whether you meant style-level `style_reference_images`.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description:
Get your balance, plan usage left (%) and API job slots in use.

Reads /v2/inferences/credits plus the account usage (GET /usage). On a plan, 2 API jobs run at
once on plan usage; usage.api_job_slots shows how many are busy.

tools.name: estimate_inference_cost
tools.description:
Estimate generation cost using the public /v2/inferences endpoint with check_cost=true.

Use `input_image` for the main source image, `reference_images` for extra per-inference guidance,
and `style_reference_images` only on create_user_style/update_user_style.

tools.name: create_inference
tools.description:
Generate images using the public /v2/inferences endpoint.

character/style consistency, and most go as small as 12x12 px (check list_available_styles
for each style's limits) — a small target size is never a

tools.description:

palette conversion, color reduction, pixel correction, rotation, inpainting, outpainting,

tools.description:
Recover the native pixel grid from enlarged, softened, AI-rendered, or compressed pixel art.

Standard uses the native Rust detector. Neural uses the neural reconstruction engine and
accepts optional target width and height values. This repairs existing art—it does not generate
a new image. Standard

tools.name: run_edit_tool
tools.description:
Run a canvas edit tool on an image via /v2/edit/tools/{tool_id}.

$0.001 tools (per frame for animated inputs): color_reducer, palette_converter, pixel_correction,
k_centroid_downscale, rotate. $0.01 tools: background_remover, color_style_transfer. $0.12 tools (RD Core, in
the picture's own style):

tools.name: estimate_edit_tool_cost
tools.description: Validate an edit-tool request and estimate its cost and duration without running it. Always free.

tools.name: get_inference_result
tools.description:
Retrieve retained outputs for a synchronous generation.

Use the request_id returned by create_inference to recover or refresh signed output URLs.
This lookup is read-only; never repeat a paid create_inference call just because delivery URLs
are temporarily missing.

tools.name: start_inference_job
tools.description:
Start a generation as an async job (POST /v2/inferences with async=true) and return a task_id.

Recommended for advanced animations (rd_advanced_animation__*), other animation styles, and
batches — they run for tens of seconds and can outlive a synchronous MCP call. Poll the
returned task_id with ge

tools.name: get_inference_job
tools.description:
Check the status of an async generation started with start_inference_job.

Statuses: pending, running, succeeded, failed. On success the result carries hosted
output_urls (raw base64 payloads are excluded to keep MCP outputs compact).

tools.name: list_inference_jobs
tools.description:
List your most recent async jobs, newest first (GET /v2/inferences/tasks).

Recovery path: if a submission response was lost (timeout, disconnect) before the
task_id arrived, the job was still accepted — find it here instead of re-submitting
and being charged twice. Then poll it with get_inference_j

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Check RetroDiffusion subsystem health (/v2/status, no auth). Useful before bulk generation runs.

tools.name: get_lowpoly_pricing
tools.description: Low-Poly (3D) sizes, prices per operation (generate / revise / animate), styles, limits and export targets. Free.

tools.name: estimate_lowpoly_cost
tools.description:
Price a Low-Poly job without starting it (free). For generate with size auto, returns the size auto would pick.
style prices a generate in that style (Lite styles cost less); other operations use the model's own style.

tools.name: start_lowpoly_generate
tools.description:
Start building a low-poly 3D model with pixel-art textures from a prompt and/or reference images (paid).
reference_models puts your existing models (by asset_id) into it exactly, e.g. "a tavern with my table".
Optional input_palette (a palette image, as for create_inference): the model uses only its

tools.name: start_lowpoly_revise
tools.description:
Change an existing Low-Poly model (paid, priced by its size). The result is saved as a new version.
Poll get_lowpoly_job(task_id). One job per model at a time.

tools.name: start_lowpoly_animate
tools.description:
Add an animation to a Low-Poly model version, or change an existing one by passing its name as animation
(paid, priced by size). The first animation rigs the model for free. Animations attach to the version; they do
not create a new version. Poll get_lowpoly_job(task_id).

tools.name: start_lowpoly_split
tools.description:
Break a Low-Poly model into separate models (paid, priced by its size): a desk scene becomes the desk, a
candle, each book, and so on. Each piece is a new model (and history item) facing the front, with its own
textures, rig and animations; the original is unchanged. Poll get_lowpoly_job(task_id); i

tools.name: start_lowpoly_rerig
tools.description:
Rebuild the skeleton of a rigged Low-Poly model version (paid, priced by size), e.g. to move a pivot or add
bones. The version is updated in place; animations whose bones the new rig still has are kept. Versions without
a rig are rigged for free by their first animation instead. Poll get_lowpoly_job

tools.name: get_lowpoly_job
tools.description:
Status of a Low-Poly job: pending, running, succeeded or failed. On success, the model with its versions,
render URLs and animations. Poll every 10-20 seconds; jobs take minutes.

tools.name: get_lowpoly_model
tools.description: A Low-Poly model: status, versions (render URLs, animations) and any running job.

tools.name: list_lowpoly_models
tools.description: The account's Low-Poly models, newest first.

tools.name: export_lowpoly_model
tools.description:
Export a Low-Poly model for an engine or tool and return a hosted download URL (free).
Engines (Godot, Unity, Unreal, three.js) and Blender get .glb; Blockbench gets .bbmodel; Minecraft gets a
resource pack; .glb and .bbmodel include every animation. Animated GIFs, sprite sheets and MP4 videos need

tools.name: recolor_lowpoly_model
tools.description:
Recolor a Low-Poly model's textures with the image color tools and save the result as a new version
(returns the model). Color Reducer and Palette Converter cost $0.001; Color Style Transfer costs $0.01.
Later revisions and animations keep the new colors.

tools.name: delete_lowpoly_animation
tools.description:
Delete one animation from a Low-Poly model's version (free) and return the model. The rig stays, so animating
again needs no new rig. This cannot be undone.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_inference" is 1919 chars, far longer than this server's median (246). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_edit_tools, get_inference_result, get_lowpoly_job, get_lowpoly_model, export_lowpoly_model · Private data: authenticate, logout, fix_pixel_art, start_lowpoly_generate · Public sink: list_edit_tools, fix_pixel_art, start_inference_job · Destructive: delete_user_style, get_balance, create_inference, run_edit_tool, start_inference_job, delete_lowpoly_animation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_edit_tools, get_inference_result, get_lowpoly_job, get_lowpoly_model, export_lowpoly_model · Private data: authenticate, logout, fix_pixel_art, start_lowpoly_generate · Public sink: list_edit_tools, fix_pixel_art, start_inference_job · Destructive: delete_user_style, get_balance, create_inference, run_edit_tool, start_inference_job, delete_lowpoly_animation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
